_comment: token: a CLASSIC PAT with repo + read:org — fine-grained tokens reach only one org each, and this board spans several. The API is called directly, so the gh CLI is not needed. Keep this file chmod 600.
_token_comment: Classic GitHub token; leave empty to read the named environment variable.
_token_env_comment: Environment variable that holds the GitHub token.
_enterprise_hostname_comment: Web hostname of a GitHub Enterprise Cloud tenant (for example acme.ghe.com). A *.ghe.com host is called at api.<host>. Empty reads the variable enterprise_hostname_env names, if any; otherwise github.com.
_enterprise_hostname_env_comment: Name of an environment variable to read when enterprise_hostname is empty, for example GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_HOSTNAME. Empty reads none. This is a variable name, never a hostname.
_accounts_comment: GitHub users or organizations to include; empty discovers the viewer and their organizations.
_window_days_comment: Days included in delivery charts and summaries.
_share_readings_comment:
Share readings with every other github pane on this machine, so one pane asks GitHub and the rest read its answer. On by default.

Shared: who the token belongs to, the contribution calendar, and the board's totals for each set of accounts and window - org and account names and counts, never a token or a PR title. Day counts and merged-PR timing are still asked by each pane. When GitHub says the rate limit is spent, every github pane on that host and token stops asking until it resets.

The readings are kept in one small file, github.sqlite in ~/.local/state/opscope, readable only by you. A reading nobody has written for a day is deleted the next time a pane writes to the store. Turn it off to have this pane ask on its own; the line under the status line says which it is doing.
